description: The N=2 and N=3 Ocneanu traces on H_3(q) are not proportional, so the mass pipeline cannot be re-tuned to N=3: T3f's soft constraint is hard, and an N=3 flavour channel must be a SEPARATE trace. Beans qou-w5fw (T3f), qou-8p1x.

computation.arithmetic: exact Fraction; q-hook-content formula; no floating point

data.mechanism: tr_M = sum_lambda y_lambda chi_lambda with chi_lambda N-independent and y_lambda ~ s_lambda(1,q,...,q^{N-1}), the principal specialisation; all N-dependence sits in the weights
data.verdict: N = 2 is locked in for the mass pipeline; moving to N = 3 re-weights the surviving channels, not merely adds the singlet. T3f's soft constraint is hard. An N = 3 flavour channel must therefore be a SEPARATE trace, which is permitted -- the Ocneanu trace is a family and HnMarkovTrace.lean types the parameter as a free class field.
data.scope: scope-(b) for the claim 'the N=2 and N=3 Ocneanu traces on H_3(q) differ by an overall normalisation', excluded by exact computation of the weight ratio
not_claimed: that N = 2 is derived from the Descartes condition -- why the mass channel is the N=2 one remains open
that the N=3 trace reproduces any flavour observable (the Gavrilik test TG, untouched here)
anything about colour SU(3) -- this is the flavour channel
